tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Pre-qualification Criteria:1.Manufacturer or their authorized dealers of CCTV Surveillance System are eligible to participate in the tender. The Manufacturers should submit the Certificate of Incorporation/Certificate of Registration issued by the concerned Authority. In case of Authorized dealer, they should submit the Authorization certificate issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer MAF for each line item. 2.Manufacturer or their authorized dealers of CCTV Surveillance System must have minimum average annual turnover of Rs.1.00 Crores for proceeding 3 financials years. In proof, the bidder should submit Audited balance sheet, Profit & Loss Account and CA Certificate for all the three years. 3.The bidder can quote for more than one OEM make for different materials as per bill of materials. The OEM should have presence in India from past 5 years. 4.The bidder should supply only STQC Standardisation Testing and Quality Certification certified CCTV system and related materials. 5.The supplied CCTV Surveillance System all its accessories should meet the Testing parameters, certifications & all other legal requirements as stipulated by all Government agencies/Local authorities/Police regulations/Laws etc.6.The bidder should have experience of implementing at list one similar project at least 50 cameras in one work order totaling to 100 cameras in multiple work orders in Government/PSU/Pvt entity/Defense/Police department in previous three years. In proof, the firm should submit satisfactory work completion certificate.
